voice: a warm first-person diary-like log the user keeps and shares with their assistant
format: flowing paragraphs grouped by date headings like 'Tuesday, 5 March 2024'; rules phrased as the user's own resolutions; the request at the end as 'Note to assistant:' followed by the pending item
verbosity: verbose; long sentences with some personal colour that adds no new facts
notes: Do not invent events, opinions or reasons. Personal colour must be generic (weather, mood) and must not bear on any rule, preference or option.
